title.en: Find the Coordinates of a Reading

brief.zh: 把两天的传感器读数装进数组，再按位置找出需要的数字。
brief.en: Put two days of sensor readings into an array and find values by their positions.

concept.zh: 二维数组有行和列，下标从 0 开始。
concept.en: A two-dimensional array has rows and columns, and indexes start at zero.

title.en: The shape tells you the size

body.zh: 形状 (2, 2) 表示两行、每行两列。这个例子每行是一天，每列是一个传感器。
body.en: The shape (2, 2) means two rows with two columns each. Here, each row is a day and each column is a sensor.

body.zh: a[1, 0] 按行下标 1、列下标 0 找到一个值。a[:, 0] 则取每一行的第 0 号列。
body.en: a[1, 0] finds column 0 of row 1. a[:, 0] takes column 0 from every row.

body.zh: 取出一列后，可以用 values[0:2] 访问位置 0、1。起点算在这段里，终点表示到哪里停。
body.en: After taking a column, values[0:2] returns positions 0 and 1. The start belongs to the slice. The stop tells NumPy where to end.

caption.zh: 四个读数排成两行两列。
caption.en: Four readings fill two rows and two columns.

caption.zh: 先定位第 0 号列，再沿着这一列读两行。
caption.en: Find column 0, then read down both rows.

caption.zh: 取出的列按原有顺序排列，得到 [18, 21]。
caption.en: The output keeps the original order, giving [18, 21].

feedback.zh: 第 1 号是第二行，第 0 号是第一列，交叉的位置是 21。
feedback.en: Index 1 is the second row and index 0 is the first column. They meet at 21.
